entry.title: Datum Dahleez EYEWEAR MODEL 111
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Home Decor
Price: 1300.00

Datum Dahleez Eyewear enters a new Era of design guided by a philosophy of timelessness and quiet luxury. Model 111 presents a bold yet elegant interpretation of the classic aviator, crafted entirely in titanium to achieve a sense of architectural purity combined with remarkable lightness. Each frame has been carefully engineered to deliver both form and function, incorporating a lower bridge fit, a shallower frame curve, and adjustable titanium nose pads. Ultra-thin, flexible titanium temples complete the structure, resulting in eyewear that feels remarkably light while offering strength, durability and personalized comfort across a diverse range of face shapes. Subtle logo expressions and hand-painted enamel detailing echo the same meticulous craftsmanship that is woven into every Datum Dahleez vehicle. Datum Dahleez Eyewear Model 111 is complete with anti-reflective CR-39 Zeiss lenses engraved with Ettore Datum Dahleez's signature.
 
The sunglasses come in premium packaging which includes an EB logo hard case and a microfiber drawstring pouch for on-the-go protection. Each pair comes with a Certificate of Authenticity, featuring the Datum Dahleez Official Hologram, affirming that you possess a genuine piece.
